description: This file defines the StatelessWorkerDirector class, which implements the IPlacementDirector interface. The class is responsible for determining the placement of stateless worker silos in Orleans, either placing an activation on the local silo if compatible or choosing a random compatible silo otherwise.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerDirector
classes.description: Implements placement logic for stateless worker silos, directing activations to local or compatible silos.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the target silo for new activation, prioritizing local silo if compatible, otherwise selecting a random compatible silo.
